capabilities.name: Structured audit event schema
capabilities.description: A versioned JSON Schema defines audit event identity, actor, action, target, outcome, timestamps, and evidence references.
limitations: Schema validation does not authenticate the event issuer or prove the event occurred.

capabilities.name: SHA-256 hash-chained JSONL records
capabilities.description: A local append and verification tool links audit records with SHA-256 digests and detects modification or reordering within the checked log.
limitations: A hash chain is not a digital signature, trusted timestamp, immutable storage guarantee, or authenticated ingestion service.

capabilities.name: Local audit append and verify CLI
capabilities.description: A command-line tool appends structured records and verifies the integrity of an existing JSONL chain.
limitations: No remote collector, access-control service, or retention manager is included.

capabilities.name: Signed audit checkpoints
capabilities.description: Publish verifiable signed checkpoints anchored to independently managed trust roots.
limitations: Cryptographic signatures and checkpoint verification are not implemented.
